name: blueprint
title: Blueprint
summary: Precise technical look: neutral grotesk, monospaced labels, visible grid and thin rules. For developer tools, APIs, infrastructure, documentation and data-heavy admin screens.
imagery: Diagrams, code, terminal output and real product screenshots; no photography of people, no illustrations.
rules: Headlines in IBM Plex Sans 600, tight and left-aligned; body 14-16 px weight 400.
Labels, metadata, numbers and table headers in IBM Plex Mono 12-13 px; uppercase only for short labels.
Structure with 1 px rules in the line colour and a visible column grid; radius 4 px at most.
Dense but even spacing on a 4 px grid; align everything to shared left edges.
Accent only for interactive elements, focus and one status highlight; status colours stay muted.
No shadows, no gradients, no decorative blobs.
Show real data: code samples, numbers with units, ids, timestamps.
